acceptedRunScope: The 108-capture/10424-assertion run applies to the frozen snapshot and actual GUI build recorded in accepted/. Unrelated concurrent source changes are preserved. No rebuild, revert, stage or modification of those files was performed.
previewVerification: Selected dark compact enabled/disabled and light detailed disabled native images show matching 38x16pt capsule bounds at x288, y4. The visible blue and disabled gray bezels have consistent width; the 9pt X is complete and unclipped. Native glass/capsule styling is checked on macOS 26. NSView frame height alone is not treated as visible bezel height.
visualEvidenceLimitations: Existing -unselected-module crops are excluded from visual conclusions because the known scrolling capture can show the upper Power History area. Selected module and new disabled-module captures are the visual evidence used here.

Disabled behavior is checked as the actual NSButton isEnabled=false state, with a frame equal to the enabled button. This run does not inject a separate mouse event into the disabled button. Enabled action uses native mouse tracking and verifies the exact process identity.

Battery and process readings are fixtures. The GUI never signals user processes. The separate root-worker probe signals only its own child and does not install or exercise the canonical LaunchDaemon/socket.
